about.text: A low-fat feta-type cheese made from cow milk with 15% or 30% camel milk blended in, from a UAE laboratory study. The 30% camel blend held more moisture after 14 days of ripening than the cow-milk cheese, and it is not confirmed as sold in the UAE.
